// Unmodified matching algorithm from the MIT-licensed original HEC explorer.
// Copyright (c) 2026 High-Entropy Ceramics Database contributors.
function rowMatchesSelection(sites, selected) {
  const siteElementSets = Object.values(sites);
  if (selected.length === 1) {
    return siteElementSets.some((siteElements) => siteElements.has(selected[0]));
  }

  return siteElementSets.some((siteElements) =>
    selected.every((element) => siteElements.has(element))
  );
}
